scope: Labelled hypotheses for April calendar names without a local source.
method: As round 139 (build-r143.mjs = helpers of write-r136.mjs + preamble and O of r139-data.mjs + r143-data.mjs). Names with a root history, a reviewed history or an existing hypothesis were skipped; Names with a documented phonetic-formation note were also skipped. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).

records.name: Dagna
